pi-836e40ab1341496ca0246dc01ccdd80f.name: attention_is_all_you_need.pdf
pi-836e40ab1341496ca0246dc01ccdd80f.description: This document provides an in-depth introduction to the Transformer model, a novel deep learning architecture that replaces sequential recurrent layers with multi-headed self-attention, resulting in improved parallelization, faster training times, and state-of-the-art results in machine translation tasks.

pi-ecfa131288be432e92c1da24a3c14608.name: attention_is_all_you_need_1.pdf
pi-ecfa131288be432e92c1da24a3c14608.description: The Transformer model is a sequence transduction model that relies entirely on attention mechanisms to draw global dependencies between input and output, achieving state-of-the-art results in machine translation and constituency parsing tasks.

pi-d38df3745a954cb289d965ffbfd15982.name: attention_is_all_you_need_2.pdf
pi-d38df3745a954cb289d965ffbfd15982.description: This paper introduces the Transformer model, a state-of-the-art sequence transduction model that relies entirely on attention mechanisms to draw global dependencies between input and output sequences, allowing for significantly more parallelization and improved translation quality.

pi-f60561d4418d4cc5bc17ad3ba72181f0.name: attention_is_all_you_need_3.pdf
pi-f60561d4418d4cc5bc17ad3ba72181f0.description: The Transformer is a novel neural network architecture that replaces traditional recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with self-attention mechanisms, achieving state-of-the-art results in machine translation tasks and other sequence transduction tasks.

pi-96f0f9b87aab4851ae3f2ff5096d9e85.name: attention_is_all_you_need_4.pdf
pi-96f0f9b87aab4851ae3f2ff5096d9e85.description: This document describes a novel sequence transduction model called the Transformer, which replaces traditional recurrent neural networks with attention mechanisms to achieve state-of-the-art results in machine translation and other tasks.
